verdict.rationale: Lambda serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json, and a runtime probe confirmed it returns the full OpenAPI 3.1 'Lambda Cloud API' spec without an API key. The 404s on docs.lambda.ai candidate paths only show the spec lives on a different host; they do not contradict that it is downloadable. Missing for 10: the docs pages in evidence never link to the spec, and no independent community report confirms using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json serves the full Lambda Cloud API OpenAPI 3.1 spec (title 'Lambda Cloud API', documented rate limits: 1 req/s general, launch limited per 12s) keylessly
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
